Target-filtered resolution is dependency-closure evidence, not platform qualification or successful compilation.
Licenses are package metadata observations and have not been independently legally reviewed.

risk_classification.change_rule: Lowering an assigned tier or tier floor requires retained rationale in a new AR-0010 review cycle.

entries.rationale: Directly derives password-based key-encryption keys; behavior and parameter compatibility affect database unlock semantics.
Directly produces and verifies authenticated page and protector ciphertext governed by Tosumu format and security claims.
Directly computes and verifies WAL framing checksums that influence replay acceptance and corruption diagnostics.
Directly defines accepted and emitted Base32 recovery-secret text, making codec behavior part of the recovery interoperability boundary.
Supplies native cooperative writer admission through platform locking; failure mapping and target behavior affect single-writer correctness but no authenticated bytes.
Directly supplies DEKs, salts, identifiers, nonces, and recovery secrets used by authenticated-storage operations.
Directly derives encryption and authentication subkeys and recovery KEKs whose compatibility is security- and format-relevant.
Directly computes and verifies header authentication tags that gate acceptance of protected database metadata.
Directly underlies HKDF/HMAC and is also used for rebuild artifact identity, so behavior affects security and publication evidence.
Generates Tosumu-owned error implementations through a procedural-macro closure; foreign error types remain private but build-time code affects public diagnostics.

Participates transitively in the encryption closure and is also declared directly; no direct Tosumu use was observed, so the declaration and enabled alloc feature require explicit review rather than assumed secret erasure.
